translation: Ta. Sin. Mim
These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain

arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بٰخِعٌ نَفسَكَ أَلّا يَكونوا مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena
translation: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not

arabic: إِن نَشَأ نُنَزِّل عَلَيهِم مِنَ السَّماءِ ءايَةً فَظَلَّت أَعنٰقُهُم لَها خٰضِعينَ
transliteration: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena
translation: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it

arabic: وَما يَأتيهِم مِن ذِكرٍ مِنَ الرَّحمٰنِ مُحدَثٍ إِلّا كانوا عَنهُ مُعرِضينَ
transliteration: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena
translation: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it

arabic: فَقَد كَذَّبوا فَسَيَأتيهِم أَنبٰؤُا۟ ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
transliteration: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
translation: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff

arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا إِلَى الأَرضِ كَم أَنبَتنا فيها مِن كُلِّ زَوجٍ كَريمٍ
transliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin
translation: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

arabic: وَإِذ نادىٰ رَبُّكَ موسىٰ أَنِ ائتِ القَومَ الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena
translation: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk
The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ إِنّى أَخافُ أَن يُكَذِّبونِ
transliteration: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni
translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me

arabic: وَيَضيقُ صَدرى وَلا يَنطَلِقُ لِسانى فَأَرسِل إِلىٰ هٰرونَ
transliteration: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona
translation: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me)

arabic: وَلَهُم عَلَىَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخافُ أَن يَقتُلونِ
transliteration: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni
translation: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me

arabic: قالَ كَلّا فَاذهَبا بِـٔايٰتِنا إِنّا مَعَكُم مُستَمِعونَ
transliteration: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona
translation: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing

arabic: فَأتِيا فِرعَونَ فَقولا إِنّا رَسولُ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
translation: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds
(Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us

arabic: قالَ أَلَم نُرَبِّكَ فينا وَليدًا وَلَبِثتَ فينا مِن عُمُرِكَ سِنينَ
transliteration: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena
translation: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us

arabic: وَفَعَلتَ فَعلَتَكَ الَّتى فَعَلتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ
transliteration: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena
translation: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates

arabic: قالَ فَعَلتُها إِذًا وَأَنا۠ مِنَ الضّالّينَ
transliteration: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena
translation: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray

arabic: فَفَرَرتُ مِنكُم لَمّا خِفتُكُم فَوَهَبَ لى رَبّى حُكمًا وَجَعَلَنى مِنَ المُرسَلينَ
transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena
translation: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him)

arabic: وَتِلكَ نِعمَةٌ تَمُنُّها عَلَىَّ أَن عَبَّدتَ بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ
transliteration: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela
translation: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel
Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds

arabic: قالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما إِن كُنتُم موقِنينَ
transliteration: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
translation: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief
(Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not
He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers

arabic: قالَ إِنَّ رَسولَكُمُ الَّذى أُرسِلَ إِلَيكُم لَمَجنونٌ
transliteration: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun
translation: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman

arabic: قالَ رَبُّ المَشرِقِ وَالمَغرِبِ وَما بَينَهُما إِن كُنتُم تَعقِلونَ
transliteration: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona
translation: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand

arabic: قالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذتَ إِلٰهًا غَيرى لَأَجعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ المَسجونينَ
transliteration: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena
translation: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners
He said: Even though I show thee something plain

arabic: قالَ فَأتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena
translation: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful

arabic: فَأَلقىٰ عَصاهُ فَإِذا هِىَ ثُعبانٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun
translation: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest

arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذا هِىَ بَيضاءُ لِلنّٰظِرينَ
transliteration: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena
translation: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders

arabic: قالَ لِلمَلَإِ حَولَهُ إِنَّ هٰذا لَسٰحِرٌ عَليمٌ
transliteration: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun
translation: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard

arabic: يُريدُ أَن يُخرِجَكُم مِن أَرضِكُم بِسِحرِهِ فَماذا تَأمُرونَ
transliteration: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona
translation: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye

arabic: قالوا أَرجِه وَأَخاهُ وَابعَث فِى المَدائِنِ حٰشِرينَ
transliteration: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena
translation: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard
So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed
And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering

arabic: لَعَلَّنا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِن كانوا هُمُ الغٰلِبينَ
transliteration: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena
translation: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners

arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قالوا لِفِرعَونَ أَئِنَّ لَنا لَأَجرًا إِن كُنّا نَحنُ الغٰلِبينَ
transliteration: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena
translation: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners

arabic: قالَ نَعَم وَإِنَّكُم إِذًا لَمِنَ المُقَرَّبينَ
transliteration: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena
translation: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me)

arabic: قالَ لَهُم موسىٰ أَلقوا ما أَنتُم مُلقونَ
transliteration: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona
translation: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw

arabic: فَأَلقَوا حِبالَهُم وَعِصِيَّهُم وَقالوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرعَونَ إِنّا لَنَحنُ الغٰلِبونَ
transliteration: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona
translation: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners

arabic: فَأَلقىٰ موسىٰ عَصاهُ فَإِذا هِىَ تَلقَفُ ما يَأفِكونَ
transliteration: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona
translation: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show
And the wizards were flung prostrate
Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds
The Lord of Moses and Aaron

arabic: قالَ ءامَنتُم لَهُ قَبلَ أَن ءاذَنَ لَكُم إِنَّهُ لَكَبيرُكُمُ الَّذى عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحرَ فَلَسَوفَ تَعلَمونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيدِيَكُم وَأَرجُلَكُم مِن خِلٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena
translation: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one

arabic: قالوا لا ضَيرَ إِنّا إِلىٰ رَبِّنا مُنقَلِبونَ
transliteration: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona
translation: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return

arabic: إِنّا نَطمَعُ أَن يَغفِرَ لَنا رَبُّنا خَطٰيٰنا أَن كُنّا أَوَّلَ المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena
translation: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers

arabic: وَأَوحَينا إِلىٰ موسىٰ أَن أَسرِ بِعِبادى إِنَّكُم مُتَّبَعونَ
transliteration: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona
translation: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued
Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners
(Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop
And lo! they are offenders against us
And lo! we are a ready host
Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings
And treasures and a fair estate
Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them
And they overtook them at sunrise

arabic: فَلَمّا تَرٰءَا الجَمعانِ قالَ أَصحٰبُ موسىٰ إِنّا لَمُدرَكونَ
transliteration: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona
translation: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught

arabic: قالَ كَلّا إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبّى سَيَهدينِ
transliteration: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni
translation: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me

arabic: فَأَوحَينا إِلىٰ موسىٰ أَنِ اضرِب بِعَصاكَ البَحرَ فَانفَلَقَ فَكانَ كُلُّ فِرقٍ كَالطَّودِ العَظيمِ
transliteration: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi
translation: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast
Then brought We near the others to that place
And We saved Moses and those with him, every one
And We drowned the others

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
Recite unto them the story of Abraham

arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ ما تَعبُدونَ
transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona
translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye

arabic: قالوا نَعبُدُ أَصنامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَها عٰكِفينَ
transliteration: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena
translation: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them
He said: Do they hear you when ye cry
Or do they benefit or harm you

arabic: قالوا بَل وَجَدنا ءاباءَنا كَذٰلِكَ يَفعَلونَ
transliteration: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona
translation: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise
He said: See now that which ye worship
Ye and your forefathers

arabic: فَإِنَّهُم عَدُوٌّ لى إِلّا رَبَّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena
translation: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds
Who created me, and He doth guide me
And Who feedeth me and watereth me
And when I sicken, then He healeth me
And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again)

arabic: وَالَّذى أَطمَعُ أَن يَغفِرَ لى خَطيـَٔتى يَومَ الدّينِ
transliteration: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni
translation: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment

arabic: رَبِّ هَب لى حُكمًا وَأَلحِقنى بِالصّٰلِحينَ
transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena
translation: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous

arabic: وَاجعَل لى لِسانَ صِدقٍ فِى الءاخِرينَ
transliteration: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena
translation: And give unto me a good report in later generations
And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight

arabic: وَاغفِر لِأَبى إِنَّهُ كانَ مِنَ الضّالّينَ
transliteration: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena
translation: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err
And abase me not on the day when they are raised

arabic: يَومَ لا يَنفَعُ مالٌ وَلا بَنونَ
transliteration: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona
translation: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

arabic: إِلّا مَن أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلبٍ سَليمٍ
transliteration: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin
translation: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart
And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil)
And hell will appear plainly to the erring

arabic: وَقيلَ لَهُم أَينَ ما كُنتُم تَعبُدونَ
transliteration: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona
translation: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

arabic: مِن دونِ اللَّهِ هَل يَنصُرونَكُم أَو يَنتَصِرونَ
transliteration: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona
translation: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
And the hosts of Iblis, together
And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein

arabic: تَاللَّهِ إِن كُنّا لَفى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin
translation: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds
It was but the guilty who misled us
Now we have no intercessors
Nor any loving friend

arabic: فَلَو أَنَّ لَنا كَرَّةً فَنَكونَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena
translation: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah)

arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم نوحٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona
translation: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me

arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me
They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee

arabic: قالَ وَما عِلمى بِما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
transliteration: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
translation: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)

arabic: إِن حِسابُهُم إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبّى لَو تَشعُرونَ
transliteration: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona
translation: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew
And I am not (here) to repulse believers
I am only a plain warner

arabic: قالوا لَئِن لَم تَنتَهِ يٰنوحُ لَتَكونَنَّ مِنَ المَرجومينَ
transliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena
translation: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death)
He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me

arabic: فَافتَح بَينى وَبَينَهُم فَتحًا وَنَجِّنى وَمَن مَعِىَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena
translation: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me

arabic: فَأَنجَينٰهُ وَمَن مَعَهُ فِى الفُلكِ المَشحونِ
transliteration: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni
translation: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship
Then afterward We drowned the others

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
(The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah)

arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم هودٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona
translation: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight
And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever
And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants
Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me
Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know
Hath aided you with cattle and sons
And gardens and watersprings

arabic: إِنّى أَخافُ عَلَيكُم عَذابَ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
transliteration: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
translation: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day

arabic: قالوا سَواءٌ عَلَينا أَوَعَظتَ أَم لَم تَكُن مِنَ الوٰعِظينَ
transliteration: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena
translation: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach
This is but a fable of the men of old
And we shall not be doomed

arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُ فَأَهلَكنٰهُم إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
(The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم صٰلِحٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona
translation: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us
In gardens and watersprings
And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees
Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful
Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me
And obey not the command of the prodigal

arabic: الَّذينَ يُفسِدونَ فِى الأَرضِ وَلا يُصلِحونَ
transliteration: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona
translation: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not
They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched

arabic: ما أَنتَ إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُنا فَأتِ بِـٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena
translation: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful

arabic: قالَ هٰذِهِ ناقَةٌ لَها شِربٌ وَلَكُم شِربُ يَومٍ مَعلومٍ
transliteration: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin
translation: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day

arabic: وَلا تَمَسّوها بِسوءٍ فَيَأخُذَكُم عَذابُ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
transliteration: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin
translation: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day
But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ العَذابُ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah)

arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم لوطٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona
translation: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males

arabic: وَتَذَرونَ ما خَلَقَ لَكُم رَبُّكُم مِن أَزوٰجِكُم بَل أَنتُم قَومٌ عادونَ
transliteration: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona
translation: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk

arabic: قالوا لَئِن لَم تَنتَهِ يٰلوطُ لَتَكونَنَّ مِنَ المُخرَجينَ
transliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena
translation: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast
He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct
My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do
So We saved him and his household, every one
Save an old woman among those who stayed behind
Then afterward We destroyed the others

arabic: وَأَمطَرنا عَلَيهِم مَطَرًا فَساءَ مَطَرُ المُنذَرينَ
transliteration: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena
translation: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah)

arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم شُعَيبٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona
translation: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
translation: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

arabic: أَوفُوا الكَيلَ وَلا تَكونوا مِنَ المُخسِرينَ
transliteration: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena
translation: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due)
And weigh with the true balance

arabic: وَلا تَبخَسُوا النّاسَ أَشياءَهُم وَلا تَعثَوا فِى الأَرضِ مُفسِدينَ
transliteration: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena
translation: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth
And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old
They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched

arabic: وَما أَنتَ إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُنا وَإِن نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الكٰذِبينَ
transliteration: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena
translation: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars

arabic: فَأَسقِط عَلَينا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّماءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena
translation: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful
He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do

arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُ فَأَخَذَهُم عَذابُ يَومِ الظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كانَ عَذابَ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
translation: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds
Which the True Spirit hath brought down
Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners
In plain Arabic speech
And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old

arabic: أَوَلَم يَكُن لَهُم ءايَةً أَن يَعلَمَهُ عُلَمٰؤُا۟ بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ
transliteration: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela
translation: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it
And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs

arabic: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيهِم ما كانوا بِهِ مُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena
translation: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it
Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

arabic: لا يُؤمِنونَ بِهِ حَتّىٰ يَرَوُا العَذابَ الأَليمَ
transliteration: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema
translation: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom
So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not
Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved
Would they (now) hasten on Our doom
Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years
And then cometh that which they were promised

arabic: ما أَغنىٰ عَنهُم ما كانوا يُمَتَّعونَ
transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona
translation: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them

arabic: وَما أَهلَكنا مِن قَريَةٍ إِلّا لَها مُنذِرونَ
transliteration: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona
translation: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
For reminder, for We never were oppressors
The devils did not bring it down
It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power
Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing

arabic: فَلا تَدعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ فَتَكونَ مِنَ المُعَذَّبينَ
transliteration: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena
translation: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed
And warn thy tribe of near kindred

arabic: وَاخفِض جَناحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena
translation: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee

arabic: فَإِن عَصَوكَ فَقُل إِنّى بَريءٌ مِمّا تَعمَلونَ
transliteration: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona
translation: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do
And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful
Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship)
Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower

arabic: هَل أُنَبِّئُكُم عَلىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطينُ
transliteration: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu
translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend
They descend on every sinful, false one
They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars
As for poets, the erring follow them

arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّهُم فى كُلِّ وادٍ يَهيمونَ
transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona
translation: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley
And how they say that which they do not

arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا وَانتَصَروا مِن بَعدِ ما ظُلِموا وَسَيَعلَمُ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبونَ
transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona
translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned
